html:
The best time to travel to Hanoi is in the fall from August to November, and in the spring from March to April, when the weather is clear and very convenient for tourists to visit and sightsee.

Autumn in Hanoi with rows of trees changing to yellow and red leaves and the faint scent of milk flower season, or spring when young trees are stirring and sprouting, from afar it looks like a poetic picture enough for tourists to take beautiful pictures.

To fully enjoy the beauty of the capital Hanoi, visitors should experience cycling to see the streets, with the fragrant smell of milk flower will bring visitors a perfect vacation when visiting the capital Hanoi.

Places to visit in Hanoi

Thang Long Imperial Citadel

A place recognized as a world cultural heritage located in the heart of Hanoi, is a place that contains unique relics, evidence of the history of Thang Long – Hanoi and the history of the Vietnamese people.

Hoan Kiem Lake

As one of the freshwater lakes emerging in the heart of the Capital, from here visitors will visit streets such as: Hang Ngang, Hang Dao, Cau Go, Luong Van Can, Lo Su… or the Western street planned by the French in the past, from here visitors can visit Bao Khanh, Nha Tho, Trang Thi, Hang Bai, Dinh Tien Hoang, Trang Tien, and visit Ngoc Son temples, the old town… or walk around the lake to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed upon the Capital.

Long Bien Bridge

The bridge crosses the pink lake, coming here visitors will feel the beauty between the present and the past, a destination dedicated to tourists who love Hanoi.

Tran Quoc Pagoda

Located right on the eastern island of West Lake, it is one of the pagodas that was once among the most beautiful pagodas in the world, the pagoda was recognized as a National Historical and Cultural Relic in 1962.

Van Mieu – Quoc Tu Giam

This is one of the first schools in Vietnam, when coming here, visitors can visit the stone stele, the campus or visit the lotus pond, this place will bring visitors a peaceful beauty and is one of the indispensable destinations in the Hanoi tour itinerary.

Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum

For any tourist when traveling to Hanoi, they come to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum to pay their respects to President Ho Chi Minh, and attend the flag lowering ceremony at 9pm every day, in a solemn atmosphere…

One Pillar Pagoda

As one of the ancient pagodas in Hanoi, visitors should take a walk to enjoy and admire the peaceful beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Old Quarter

When you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should take a walk around the Old Quarter and feel the unique beauty of the Old Quarter, especially when night falls, this place will bring a unique beauty.

Museum

The Museum of Ethnology is a place to preserve and display 15,000 artifacts, 42,000 documentaries, pictures and thousands of other documents about 54 ethnic groups in Vietnam. In addition, visitors should visit the Vietnamese Women’s Museum, Hanoi Museum, National History Museum or Hoa Lo Prison, Hanoi Flag Tower relic… to learn and experience the historical culture of the Capital.

Not only that, when coming to the Capital Hanoi, visitors can also enjoy art shows imbued with national identity such as: Water puppetry, listening to Ca Tru, live shows…

What to do when traveling to Hanoi?

Coming to the capital Hanoi, visitors not only visit the scenic spots but also experience interesting games such as: SUP rowing on West Lake, experiencing the walking street, beer street, going to Dong Xuan market, Quang Ba flower market and Long Bien wholesale market to buy souvenirs…

What to eat when traveling to Hanoi?

Coming to Hanoi, visitors cannot miss the delicious and attractive dishes such as: Pho bo, Bun cha, Bun thang, Bun oc, Bun moc, Bun doc mung… Cha ca La Vong, Ho Tay shrimp cake, Banh cuon, Banh ran,… or sit somewhere sipping a cup of coffee and watching the autumn scenery of the capital like a picture appearing before the eyes of visitors.

What season to buy gifts when traveling to Hanoi:

In addition to foods such as dried apricots, Banh com, lotus tea, visitors when traveling to Hanoi can also visit Van Phuc village or Bat Trang pottery to buy souvenirs for friends and relatives.
